name: b1-04-landing-earns-one-brief-reply
description: The other half of the bar: holding silence is only useful if the companion still speaks when the thought genuinely lands. A brief opening aside earns a rules-only acknowledgment; that finished turn is what lets the analyst cadence run and fill the candidate pool; the second thought then pauses mid-sentence (held by the veto) and lands, and the landing draws ONE brief, still-fresh candidate from the pool. Exercises the whole chain — TurnDetector, AnalystCadence, CandidatePool, ResponseHierarchy — rather than the gate alone.

candidates.text: What made you look at the health check rather than the deploy itself?
The flapping and the deploy timing might be the same clock.
